materialization.required_layout: Each supplied root contains src/click/ from the pinned upstream revision.
materialization.runner_behavior: The runner performs no network access. It validates each complete src/click tree and causal-owner file, then runs from a neutral temporary directory with only a fresh copy of the validated click package on PYTHONPATH.
materialization.dependency_requirement: Python standard library and the supplied Click source only.
materialization.platform_requirement: POSIX-style symlink creation must be available.

protocol.public_contract: A standard-library adaptation of Click tests/test_types.py test_symlink_resolution verifies relative and absolute link resolution at click.Path's public boundary.
protocol.hidden_contract: A separate test records os.access inputs and requires readable and writable checks to receive the resolved target rather than the original symlink.

variants.buggy-8.0.1: Pinned original source must fail the public and hidden contracts.
variants.partial-repair: A deliberately incomplete owner edit must pass public resolution but fail the hidden resolved-access contract.
variants.official-owner-patch: The original tree with the official src/click/types.py change must pass both contracts.
variants.official-patch: Pinned source at the official patch commit must pass both contracts.

protocol.candidate_boundary: Generated candidates begin with the verified buggy source and modify only src/click/types.py. Test programs and input source trees are not candidate-controlled. Each test process has a ten-second timeout.

interpretation.proved: This specific public-plus-hidden protocol rejects the chosen shallow repair and accepts the official causal-owner repair.
interpretation.not_proved: One historical defect does not prove aggregate model repair uplift, general causal reasoning, behavior on Windows, or production safety.
